blocks.title: How to read this report
blocks.intro: This is not a test with right or wrong answers. It shows what your answers say about you and what that could mean for your future. Treat it as advice, not a rule: nothing here is set in stone, and no single career or field is the only right choice. One field of study can lead to many different careers.

items.title: Investment Banker
items.summary: Your answers suggest a strong interest in leading, organizing, and analyzing, which aligns well with the demands of investment banking. You also show a preference for a fast-paced environment, large organizations, and a willingness to work internationally, which fits this career path. Given your interest in technology, roles within FinTech or investment banking operations that rely heavily on advanced analytical tools could be a good fit.
items.market: This career offers significant opportunities for advancement into senior leadership roles and specialized financial areas.
items.takes: To enter this field, you would typically need a bachelor's degree in a finance-related subject, business, economics, or a quantitative field, along with specific knowledge of financial markets.
items.now: It would be helpful to research the different types of roles within investment banking and financial technology to understand the day-to-day work.
items.aiTitle: How AI may change this career
tasks: Gathering and organizing large financial datasets
evidence: Global evidence: Global industry reports show that generative AI is increasingly used for automating data processing and report generation in finance, allowing professionals to focus on higher-level analysis and client interaction.

In your market: In the GCC, the adoption of AI in financial services is growing, with firms looking to improve efficiency in data-heavy tasks, but human expertise in client trust and local market understanding remains key.
items.means: As someone exploring a career in investment banking without prior experience, it would be beneficial for you to understand how data analysis tools work. Learning to interpret financial information critically and present complex ideas clearly to others would be a very good next step.

items.title: Lawyer
items.summary: Your high interest in investigative and enterprising tasks, combined with a strong focus on conventional procedures, matches the research, advocacy, and structured nature of legal work. Your communication, leadership, and strategic strengths would be valuable for courtroom arguments or client negotiation. Connecting to your interest in technology, you could explore roles in legal technology or cybersecurity law.
items.market: A legal career offers diverse paths, from specialization in specific areas of law to partnership in firms or roles in corporate legal departments.
items.takes: Becoming a lawyer typically requires completing a law degree, passing a bar examination, and gaining practical experience through internships or junior positions.
items.now: You could consider attending a free online webinar about legal careers or reading articles about specific areas of law that interest you.
items.aiTitle: How AI may change this career
tasks: Performing basic legal research to find precedents
evidence: Global evidence: Published reports show that AI can significantly reduce the time spent on legal research and document review, allowing legal professionals to focus more on strategic thinking, client advocacy, and complex problem-solving.

In your market: Legal firms in the GCC are cautiously exploring AI for efficiency in routine tasks like document review, but the human element of legal strategy, client trust, and courtroom representation remains central.
skills: Interpreting nuanced legal situations and applying ethical judgment
items.means: As someone with no work experience looking into law, developing strong critical thinking and analytical skills is very important. Understanding how to use research tools efficiently, including AI, to support complex legal reasoning would be a valuable next step.

items.title: Career Counselor
items.summary: Your balanced interest in social, investigative, enterprising, and conventional activities is well-suited for a career counselor, as you would guide individuals, analyze information, and follow structured processes. Your strengths in relationships, communication, and leadership, all scoring 100, are highly relevant for building trust and providing effective guidance. This field also connects with your interest in technology through online career platforms and educational technology.
items.market: Career counselors can advance to leadership roles in educational institutions, government agencies, or establish private practices.
items.takes: This career typically requires a bachelor's degree in fields like psychology, human resources, or education, and may benefit from further specialized training in career development.
items.now: It is recommended to research the types of certifications or entry-level training programs available for career counseling, possibly by exploring government resources like the Jadarat platform in Saudi Arabia.

items.title: Real Estate Agent
items.summary: Your strong enterprising interest, along with high scores in communication and relationships, aligns perfectly with the sales and client-facing aspects of real estate. Your conventional interest supports managing contracts and regulations, while an investigative interest helps with market analysis. You also showed a preference for a fast-paced environment, which is common in real estate. The use of technology, often called PropTech, is growing in this sector.
items.market: Real estate agents can progress to owning their own brokerage, specializing in commercial properties, or moving into real estate development.
items.takes: To work as a real estate agent, you would typically need to complete a pre-licensing course and pass a professional license examination in your country.
items.now: You could explore free online introductory videos or articles about the real estate market in Saudi Arabia and the role of a real estate agent.
items.aiTitle: How AI may change this career
evidence: Global evidence: Industry trends suggest AI tools can streamline administrative tasks and initial property searches for real estate agents, but complex sales, client relationships, and local market expertise remain human-driven.

In your market: In the GCC, real estate companies are beginning to use AI for lead generation and property matching, though the personal touch, negotiation, and deep local market knowledge are still crucial for agents.
skills: Building trust with clients and understanding their unspoken needs
items.means: As you have no work experience, focusing on developing your communication and negotiation skills would be beneficial. Understanding your local real estate market and its unique aspects could be a good next step.

items.title: Military Officer
items.summary: Your high leadership, strategic, and execution strengths, combined with strong enterprising and conventional interests, suggest a good fit for the structured and command-oriented environment of a military officer. You also indicated a leaning towards working in a large public sector organization and openness to international mobility, which fits this role. The modern military increasingly relies on advanced technology and cybersecurity, offering opportunities within your technology interests.
items.market: A military career offers clear progression paths through ranks, with opportunities for specialized training and command responsibilities.
items.takes: This career typically requires a university degree, successful completion of officer training programs, and meeting physical and other eligibility requirements.
items.now: It would be helpful to research the different branches of the armed forces in Saudi Arabia and the entry requirements for officer positions.

items.title: Life Coach
items.summary: Your strong relationship and communication strengths, combined with social and enterprising interests, suggest you enjoy helping and guiding others, which is key for a life coach. Your high openness also means you are receptive to exploring new ideas and strategies with clients. Your core values of impact and freedom would be well-addressed by empowering others and setting your own professional direction.
items.market: Life coaches can build a client base, specialize in niche areas like wellness or executive coaching, or expand into training other coaches.
items.takesLabel: WHAT IT TAKES TO GET THERE
items.takes: While formal degrees are not always required, obtaining a certification from an accredited coaching program is highly recommended to build credibility and skills.
items.now: You could search for free introductory online workshops or webinars on coaching techniques and the principles of active listening.
items.aiTitle: How AI may change this career
tasks: Tracking client goals and progress reminders
evidence: Global evidence: While AI can offer tools for self-reflection and goal setting, general trends show that the core of life coaching—human connection, empathy, and personalized guidance—is not easily replicated by technology.

In your market: The field of life coaching in the GCC continues to emphasize personal connection and understanding individual needs, with AI tools serving mostly as assistants for administrative tasks rather than replacements for human interaction.
skills: Building deep rapport and trust with clients
Adapting advice to unique individual circumstances and emotions
items.means: For someone new to the field, honing your communication and active listening skills would be essential. Considering a short course in counseling basics or psychology could be a helpful next step to better understand human behavior.

items.title: Sports Coach
items.summary: Your high scores in relationships, communication, and leadership, alongside social and enterprising interests, indicate a natural ability to motivate and guide individuals or teams. You enjoy being active and working with others, which is central to sports coaching. While you show a preference for fast-paced work, it would be helpful to develop strategies for managing workplace pressures. Your core value of impact aligns with helping athletes achieve their goals.
items.market: Sports coaches can advance from local teams to regional or national levels, specialize in specific sports, or take on administrative roles in sports organizations.
items.takesLabel: WHAT IT TAKES TO GET THERE
items.takes: This career typically requires specific sports expertise, coaching certifications relevant to the sport and age group, and practical experience in coaching.
items.now: Consider volunteering to assist a local sports team or community sports program to gain practical experience and see if this field interests you.
items.aiTitle: How AI may change this career
evidence: Global evidence: While AI can offer insights into athlete performance and help create training programs, research indicates that the motivational and interpersonal aspects of coaching require human empathy and understanding.

In your market: In the GCC, sports organizations are starting to use AI for performance analytics, but the core role of a coach in fostering team spirit and individual growth continues to rely on human connection.
skills: Motivating athletes individually and as a team
Providing personalized feedback based on observation
Adapting strategies in real-time during games
items.means: Since you are just starting out, developing your communication and relationship-building skills would be highly valuable. Gaining practical experience in helping others improve, perhaps through volunteering, could be a great next step.

items.title: Personal Trainer
items.summary: Your strong relationship and communication strengths, along with a high realistic interest, mean you enjoy working hands-on to help individuals improve their physical well-being. Your enterprising interest suggests you are good at motivating others. Your preference for fast-paced work aligns with the dynamic nature of client sessions. Your core values of impact and wealth could be met by helping clients achieve their fitness goals and building a successful client base.
items.market: Personal trainers can specialize in areas like rehabilitation or nutrition, become fitness managers, or open their own fitness studio.
items.takesLabel: WHAT IT TAKES TO GET THERE
items.takes: To become a personal trainer, you would generally need to complete a recognized personal training certification and gain knowledge in exercise science and nutrition.
items.now: You could explore free online resources or local community courses that offer basic introductions to anatomy, exercise principles, or healthy living.

blocks.t: One small step for this week, then a simple 90-day path, built around your top career match
Built around your top match: Investment Banker
Your first step this week

A good first step is to identify three online resources, such as university program pages, professional association websites, or job postings, that describe the daily tasks and required skills for a role like an Investment Banker, a Lawyer, or a Military Officer. Pay attention to how technology is mentioned or used in these roles. Why: This helps you see what these roles really involve and which ones might connect with your interest in technology, guiding your study choices.
YOU WILL PRODUCE
A short list of 3-5 key tasks and 3-5 key skills for each role.
WHEN
Within 2 days, about 45 minutes
Worksheet:
Days 2–7

Days 2-3 — We suggest you review the skills and tasks you listed from Day 1. For the role that interested you most, identify 2-3 beginner-friendly online courses or certifications that teach one of the key skills you identified. Look for free options available online. You will produce: A list of 2-3 learning options for a specific skill.

Day 4 — You could look for 2-3 people on LinkedIn or similar professional platforms who work in one of your matched careers (e.g., Investment Banker, Lawyer, or a role in legal tech) in Saudi Arabia or another GCC country. Note down their educational backgrounds and any internships or volunteer experience they list. You will produce: Short profiles of 2-3 professionals, including their education and early career steps.

Days 5-6 — Based on your findings from Day 1 and Day 4, it would help to draft 3-5 questions you would ask someone working in a role that genuinely interests you. Focus on understanding their typical day, how they got into their field, and how technology impacts their work. You will produce: A list of 3-5 specific questions for an informational interview.

Day 7 — A good way to end the week is to review what you produced: your lists of tasks, skills, learning options, professional profiles, and questions. Pick the next step you feel most excited to take, whether it's starting a short course or trying to connect with a professional. You will produce: A short summary of your top 2-3 areas of interest and one chosen next step.
Your next 90 days

Weeks 2–4 — Build momentum It would help to complete a short, free online course related to a foundational skill for a role like an Investment Banker (e.g., an introduction to financial modeling) or a Lawyer (e.g., an introduction to legal research), or in a technology area that supports these sectors.

You could identify two professional associations in Saudi Arabia or the GCC related to one of your matched careers (e.g., a finance association, a legal society, or a technology group) and explore their public resources, webinars, or events.

We suggest you write down 3-5 skills you already have (from education, personal projects, or volunteering) that could be useful in one of the matched careers like a Career Counselor, a Sports Coach, or a Military Officer, and then consider how to describe them effectively.

Months 2–3 — Build A good next step would be to look for opportunities to volunteer or participate in a project that gives you experience related to one of your matched careers. For example, helping with event organization for a sports team could give insight into Sports Coach roles, or assisting with administrative tasks in a legal office.
You might consider attending a career fair or a public talk related to one of the sectors that interest you, such as finance, legal technology, or government, to hear directly from professionals.

It would be helpful to map out potential degree or certification programs in Saudi Arabia or the GCC that align with your preferred career direction, focusing on those that could lead to roles like an Investment Banker, a Lawyer, or a Life Coach, paying attention to the technology aspects if that remains a strong interest.
Your skills to build and practice exercise: Investment Banker
SKILLS TO BUILD

Data Interpretation and Critical Analysis — AI tools can process vast amounts of financial data quickly, so being able to understand what that data means, question its assumptions, and identify key insights for strategic advice will be crucial.

Strategic Communication — While AI can draft reports, explaining complex financial concepts clearly and persuasively to clients, building trust, and negotiating deals still requires human communication skills.
PRACTICE EXERCISE

A good exercise would be to find a simple public company's financial report online. Use a free AI tool to summarize the key financial health indicators. Then, review the AI's summary. Write a short explanation of what the numbers mean for a potential investor, focusing on any points the AI might have missed or simplified too much. Explain your reasoning.
YOU WILL HAVE
You will have the original financial summary, the AI-generated summary, and your refined explanation, with notes on how you improved upon the AI's output.

Your strong abilities in building relationships, communicating clearly, and leading people are excellent assets. These skills, along with your desire for a good reputation and freedom in your work, make a career as a Real Estate Agent a suitable path for you to consider. This progression can help you establish a respected professional presence in the market.

It is recommended to complete a real estate agent certification program. These programs teach you about property laws, market practices, and how to work ethically in the real estate business in the GCC.

You could seek an entry-level position or an internship with a real estate agency in a GCC country, such as Saudi Arabia or the UAE. This would give you hands-on experience and help you learn from others in the field.
Consider taking a short course focused on sales techniques or negotiation skills. These courses can help you use your communication strengths effectively when working with clients and managing deals.

intro: Courses that build the skills your matched careers need. These are for later: use them as a guide when you are ready, not something to do all at once.

items.title: Financial Modeling & Valuation Analyst (FMVA)
items.about: What it is about: This certification covers industry-standard financial modeling and valuation.
items.why: Understanding how to build financial models and value companies is a key part of an investment banker's daily work.

items.title: Islamic Finance and Banking
items.about: What it is about: This course teaches the basics of Shariah-compliant banking and Islamic financial tools.
items.why: For working in Saudi Arabia, knowing about Islamic finance is very important for an investment banker to advise clients well.

items.title: Real Estate Finance and Investment
items.about: What it is about: This course covers how to value properties, arrange financing, and analyze real estate investments.
items.why: A real estate agent often needs to understand property values and how deals are financed to help clients effectively.

items.title: Negotiation Mastery
items.about: What it is about: This course provides practical ways to negotiate and resolve disagreements.
items.why: A real estate agent spends a lot of time negotiating prices and terms between buyers and sellers.

items.title: Contract Law
items.about: What it is about: This course explains the main rules about how contracts are made, enforced, and broken.
items.why: Understanding contract law is a basic and very important part of a lawyer's job, as many legal matters involve agreements.

items.title: Compliance and Risk Management
items.about: What it is about: This course covers company rules, looking at risks, and meeting official standards.
items.why: Lawyers often help companies follow rules and manage risks, which is a key part of this type of legal work.

items.title: Emotional Intelligence
items.about: What it is about: This course helps you learn about yourself, understand others, and manage your relationships.
items.why: A life coach needs strong emotional intelligence skills to connect with clients and help them through their challenges.

items.title: Mental Health First Aid
items.about: What it is about: This course teaches you how to spot and respond to mental health issues in a work setting.
items.why: A life coach might work with people facing personal difficulties, so knowing how to recognize mental health signs is very helpful.

blocks.t: John, your strong blend of leadership, organizational skills, and analytical thinking, combined with your drive for recognition and connection, offers a rich foundation for many fulfilling career paths. By actively exploring study options and understanding how your strengths align with roles in areas like finance, legal, or public service, you can build a career that truly resonates with your unique profile and ambitions.
